'''Flametail''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Sparkit]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Flarevix]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "'Always looks like Flametail is smiling, right? That's just a front. Watch the tail closely. If it's swaying ever so gently... something's afoot.' --Tatari Observation Diary"

Flametail is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small fox characterized by its poppy red and off-white color palette. The tips of its ears and its feet are black, and it had teardrop-shaped eyebrows. It has a large head and a bushy tail that is half the size of its body. Its eyes appear to be perpetually shut.

Flametail's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with light blue, off-white with pure white, and black with dark blue.

==Evolution Trial==
Flametail's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Flarevix]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Flametail to increase stats 3 times.
* Play Snowboard Sprint/Marathon Party (use x2000 boards) or Cozy Farm (use x4000 fertilizer)

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Flametail loves to make fireworks out of Zobos. Squinty eyes always mean they're super powerful."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/26, Flametail was named Firefox. 
* Prior to the update on ?/?/2026, its bio description said: "Always squinting as if smiling, Flametail eavesdrops on conversations between trainers, though no one knows how much of it is understood."
